GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rider advised that his mount pulled too hard during the event which was the principal reason in his view for his mount’s disappointing showing. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. back to 3rd 800 metres. hooked 3 Wide turn. weakened in Straight . Every Chance # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly.  When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of gelding, rider advised that his mount had raced flat today and did not respond to his riding in the straight.  A post-race veterinary examination did not reveal any abnormalities.  Trainer concurred with the views of the rider and advised that the gelding would now be sent for a spell.
